title: The dog objects
logline: Wednesday. Week four. The travelogue is going to Bandon. The dog will not get in the car. Four panels of a dog sitting on the alley's gravel with his back to a Datsun. The travelogue stalls at Yachats.

panels.composition: The alley. The Datsun, door open. WOOD in the driver's seat. BARNABY on the gravel, sitting, facing away from the car.
panels.caption: DAY 17. The expedition prepares for Bandon.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, an old dog sitting on alley gravel with its back turned to a rusted small car whose door is open, a thin man in the driver's seat waiting

panels.composition: Wood out of the car. Crouching. The dog's back.

balloons.text: It's Bandon. There's a cheese factory.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man crouching to speak to an old dog who keeps his back turned, the dog's thought balloon empty

panels.composition: Wood back in the car. The engine. The dog, sitting. Not moving. The car not moving either.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a rusted car idling in an alley with its door open and an old dog sitting motionless on the gravel outside it, no words

panels.composition: The engine off. Wood on the gravel beside the dog, both facing away from the car. The caption, small.

characters.pose: sitting on the gravel beside the dog

panels.caption: The expedition is postponed. Yachats will stand as our farthest point.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man sitting on alley gravel beside an old dog with both of their backs to a parked car, a small caption box

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: The dog ends the travelogue. Yachats: the farthest point.
